newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Minister Adrian Severin said the country's bilateral treaty with Ukraine was not a prerequisite, but was important for Romania's integration into the NATO.
* A parliamentary foreign affairs commission asked support from Romania's diaspora for the country's integration into Euro-Atlantic structures.
* Romania's Foreign Ministry had completed an analysis on the stage of negotiations on a bilateral treaty between Romania and Russia, ministry spokeswoman Gilda Lazar said at a news conference.
* Romania's government plans to settle the issue of the status of Romania's ex-king Michael as an act of historic reparation.
